sights.address: Akan-chō, Ashoro, Ashoro District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: One of Hokkaido's 'three mystical lakes' at the western edge of Akan-Mashū — its colour shifts with the light under the volcano Me-Akan, whose lava dammed it.

sights.address: Route 243, Bihoro / Teshikaga border, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A 525 m pass on Route 243 with the widest view over Lake Kussharo, Japan's largest caldera lake — sea of clouds at dawn.

sights.address: Kiyosato, Shari District, Hokkaido, Japan (forest NE of Lake Mashū)
sights.w: 'Child of the Gods' pond, fed underground from Lake Mashū — 12,000 tonnes a day of cobalt spring water that never freezes, sunken logs visible 5 m down.

sights.n: Okhotsk Drift Ice Museum & Mt Tento Observatory (オホーツク流氷館)
sights.address: Mt Tento summit, Abashiri, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Real drift ice in a sub-zero room and a 360° rooftop view over the Sea of Okhotsk from the top of Mt Tento.
The easternmost point of Hokkaido's mainland at the tip of the Nemuro Peninsula — Japan's earliest sunrise, looking out toward the Habomai islets.
A long, hooked sand spit curling into the Nemuro Strait — ghostly salt-killed forests, seals and wildflowers.

sights.n: Wakkanai Port North Breakwater Dome (稚内港北防波堤ドーム)
sights.w: A 14 m-high arcade of columns built over five years to shelter travellers walking between the harbour and the railway station from waves and northern winds — a Hokkaido Heritage.

sights.n: Sōya Hills & the White Road (宗谷丘陵)
sights.w: Hills shaped in the last Ice Age behind Cape Sōya, rich in wild birds and alpine plants — the 'White Road' is paved with crushed scallop shells.

sights.address: Funadomari, Rebun, Rebun District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Rebun's northernmost point and trailhead of the island's 4- and 8-hour coastal hikes.

sights.n: Momoiwa Observatory & Trail, Rebun (桃岩展望台)
sights.address: Motochi, Rebun, Rebun District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: The 'peach rock' dome above Motochi — alpine flowers with Rishiri-Fuji across the water along the ridge trail.

sights.address: Oshidomari, Rishirifuji, Rishiri District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A small pond in primeval forest whose still surface mirrors Rishiri-Fuji upside down — an 800 m boardwalk loop.
